_readme: Single source of truth for business details. Run `python3 scripts/build.py` after editing (Netlify does this on every deploy). Empty strings/lists are omitted from the site and structured data rather than shown as placeholders.
_siteUrl: Production domain, e.g. https://www.example.com (no trailing slash). Leave empty to use the SITE_URL environment variable, then Netlify's URL variable (your primary domain). Set this or SITE_URL once a custom domain is live.
description: Jian-Xing Wu is a REALTOR® with Pinnacle Real Estate Group helping first-time buyers, families, and home sellers in the San Gabriel Valley and Inland Empire, including Diamond Bar, Walnut, Rowland Heights, Hacienda Heights, Pomona, Chino Hills, West Covina, and El Monte.
_email: Business email, e.g. jian@example.com. Shown in the contact section, footer and structured data once set.
_address: Office street address, city and ZIP. Only CA/US are filled in; nothing is shown on the site until streetAddress is set.

services.name: Home buyer representation
services.description: Guidance for first-time buyers and families from pre-approval through closing, with comparable-sales data for every offer.

services.name: Home seller representation
services.description: Pricing, preparation, and marketing guidance for homeowners selling in the San Gabriel Valley and Inland Empire.

services.name: Free home value estimate and market analysis
services.description: An instant automated estimate, followed by a free, more detailed comparative market analysis from Jian.

_languages: Languages spoken, e.g. ["English", "Mandarin"]. Shown in About and structured data once set.
_hours: Opening hours in schema.org format, e.g. [{"days": ["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"], "opens": "09:00", "closes": "18:00"}]. Leave empty to omit.
_social: Full profile URLs (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Zillow agent profile...). Used for footer links and schema sameAs.
_privacyContact: Email or address for privacy requests on /privacy/. Falls back to the phone number when empty.
